name: Trevecca Nazarene University
tuition_note: Private university, single published rate for all students. 2026-27 tuition $34,100 + student resource fee $1,550 = $35,650 tuition & fees, from trevecca.edu/admissions/financial-aid/tuition-costs. Housing (room only) $5,200/yr from same page (board/food is a separate $6,200).
